idea: Noob vs Pro vs Hacker try the same Roblox challenge; each scene escalates, the Hacker's over-the-top method looks unbeatable, then a twist at the end lets the Noob win or everything backfires.

Lil bro (a Roblox kid) causes chaos at home with his Roblox family (mom, big bro); one incident escalates scene by scene into a huge disaster with a punchline ending. Proven 33M-view 'Lil bro ___ 💀' series.
POV: you made the admin angry in a trending Roblox game (Steal a Brainrot, 99 Nights in the Forest, Grow a Garden, Escape Tsunami); the admin's revenge escalates each scene and ends with a twist.
title_pattern: POV: You made the Admin angry in ___ 💀

idea: 1% vs 50% vs 100% vs 1000% vs 1000000% of something (power, effort, rage, speed) shown as 5 escalating scenes, the last one absurdly huge.
The Noob tries to survive a famous Roblox game (99 Nights in the Forest, Doors, Escape Tsunami, Natural Disasters); tension builds every scene and the ending is a surprising way he survives or fails.
A relatable kid moment ('When mom says 5 more minutes', 'When you see a mosquito at 3AM') blown up into epic Roblox cartoon action, escalating to a ridiculous ending.
Rich Roblox kid vs poor Noob compete (birthday, school day, building a house); the rich kid flexes harder each scene but the poor Noob wins with a clever twist at the end.

Noob is offered 5 escalating Roblox powers/items one by one and must pick one to keep forever, each scene shows that power going hilariously out of control, and the final absurd choice backfires so the worst-looking first pick was secretly the best.
